output.explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 137 to 95 lines (30.7%) and from 11,139 to 7,455 characters (33.1%). It retains modular boundaries and dependencies [M], invocation paths [C], responsibility and lifetime [O], and reconstruction dependencies [D]. Five peripheral trees expand retry state, batch acceptance, checkpoint encoding, publication, and selective reads. Positions use measured text dimensions with horizontal gaps of at least 8 characters and vertical gaps of 6 lines.

Grounding: retry uses workspacePersistence.ts, recordStorage.ts, workspaceStorage.worker.ts and workspaceRecords.ts; commit uses workspaceRecordStore.ts, workspaceRecords.ts, immutableRecords.ts and diagramRevisionStore.ts; codec uses canvasCheckpointRecords.ts and workspaceRecords.ts; publish uses diagramService.ts, projectCatalogRepository.ts, canvasCatalogStore.ts, workspaceRecordStore.ts, diagramPersistence.ts and workspaceService.ts; reads uses diagramPersistence.ts, canvasCatalogStore.ts, workspaceRecordStore.ts and the worker. Added details include the 512-character text threshold, reversible reference diffs, identity-based restoration reuse, exact retry timing, transfer-mode checks, and source-binding cache invalidation.

Corrections and qualifications: loadDiagramSourceBindings passes all catalog revisions' histories, so its scan is not restricted to representations' current published revisions. Workspace publication waits for every writer even on failure, but a writer rejection throws BEFORE blob-directory sync and manifest publication. Capture hydrates only the selected head and bound revisions, but retains references to every checkpoint/revision/item key for that document. Workspace history=current changes validation, not the set of manifest blobs loaded on a cache miss. Queues are module-local per root or instance-local; cross-process locking is not established.

Only the supplied point, seed and pinned source text were used as evidence. HTTP route/transport composition and the writeJsonAtomic implementation are not supplied: the central tree marks the wiring gap, and catalog write ordering is shown without asserting its fsync implementation. DiagramRevisionStore has no explicit fsync; workspace atomic writes and the separate publishJson helper do. No blob reclamation appears in these sources; its absence elsewhere is unknown.

Retry state: browser + worker [C/O]
|-- RecordStorage.batch(changes)
|   |-- Recursive equality skips unchanged values; pending coalesces by key
|   `-- Optimistic cache changes immediately; sequence increments per changed batch
|-- Scheduling and one flight
|   |-- Default debounce: 150 ms; pending edits wait at most 1000 ms to trigger pump
|   |-- Freeze requestId + expectedRevision + changes + sequence
|   |-- New edits accumulate in pending while this flight is unresolved
|   `-- Retry delay: min(30000, 500 * 2^min(failures, 6)) ms
|-- Worker write
|   |-- Normalize changes once; cache serialized body by requestId
|   |-- Success: update known records from submitted body; discard body
|   |-- Parsed HTTP 4xx: discard body; raise REJECTED
|   `-- Server/transport uncertainty: retain body for the same request ID
|-- RecordStorage acknowledgement
|   |-- Success: advance revision and persisted sequence; clear flight/error
|   `-- Failure: keep flight; REJECTED or conflict text stops automatic scheduling
|-- commit(changes)
|   |-- Flush earlier work, snapshot cache, batch changes, await flush
|   |-- REJECTED: restore cache; clear pending/flight; throw
|   `-- Other failure: wait 500 ms and retry; disposal ends this loop
|-- Lifecycle
|   |-- flush captures a sequence target; later edits need not be acknowledged
|   |-- dispose clears timer/listeners; callers must flush for orderly close
|   `-- Worker restart: read state before projecting a replacement's deleted keys
`-- Persistence normalization [D]
    |-- canvasViewChanges normalizes a clone before encoding
    |-- Conversation pending/progress and generating surfaces become reload-safe state
    `-- normalizeRecord skips encoded canvas-view-v1; worker preserves that projection

Workspace batch acceptance and publication [C/D/O]
|-- WorkspaceRecordStore.apply: queue keyed by root within this module
|   `-- Queue entry is removed when its latest operation settles
|-- Request gate
|   |-- requestId: 1-150 word/hyphen characters; expectedRevision: safe integer
|   |-- At most 100000 changes; no duplicate keys; each change is value XOR delete
|   |-- Hash full batch JSON; compare receipt before checking expectedRevision
|   |   |-- Matching receipt -> return its prior revision
|   |   `-- Different hash -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   `-- No receipt + stale expectedRevision -> VERSION_CONFLICT
|-- Candidate validation
|   |-- Existing revision/item values cannot change; deletions are processed separately
|   |-- Re-encoded checkpoints must have equal stateKey after expansion
|   |   `-- Ignore transactionId in this comparison; check transfer links separately
|   |-- Index: project matches, <=100 unique documents, active ID belongs to list
|   |-- Require metadata, baseline, history and canvas for every indexed document
|   |-- Reject orphan keys; verify changed item hashes and affected histories
|   `-- Transfers: distinct source/destination, all before/after checkpoints exist
|       `-- Destination-after links transaction; move also requires source-after link
|-- Private publish(manifest, records, keys)
|   |-- Up to 8 writers hash JSON; reuse equal blobs or create temporary files
|   |-- New blob: exclusive open -> write -> file sync -> close -> rename
|   |-- Await every writer, even on failure
|   |   `-- Any rejection throws before blob-directory sync and manifest publication
|   |-- Success: sync blob directory when records remain among changed keys
|   `-- Atomic manifest replacement publishes pointers + revision + receipt
|       `-- Temp write/sync/close -> rename -> directory sync; cleanup in finally
|-- Failure after manifest rename
|   `-- May already be published; storage-unavailable invites receipt-based retry
`-- Durability boundaries
    |-- Deletions remove pointers; supplied code does not reclaim blob files
    |-- DiagramRevisionStore uses temp write/rename/cleanup without explicit fsync
    |-- The publishJson helper explicitly syncs file and parent directory
    `-- Catalog writeJsonAtomic implementation is outside the supplied evidence

Checkpoint codec: shared values and bounded deltas [M/D/O]
|-- CanvasValueEncoder owns known JSON -> hash, pending items and all items
|   |-- Split independently edited objects; retain ordering in parent skeletons
|   |   `-- Boundaries include scene children, edges, bindings and view selections
|   |-- Root skeleton is keyed by JSON path []; extracted positions become null
|   |-- Strings >=512 characters, or named sourceAscii, become canvas-text items
|   `-- canvas-value stores skeleton + [path, text hash] pairs; SHA-256 deduplicates
|-- CanvasCheckpointEncoder owns prior encoded checkpoints and value encoder
|   |-- Strip id/parentId/transactionId from payload before value encoding
|   |-- Available parent with depth <31 -> delta against parent's reference map
|   |-- Otherwise depth 0 with no baseId; retain logical parentId
|   |-- Existing ID: reference map and parentId must match; transactionId may change
|   `-- Emit checkpoints + new items (or all items) + optional materialized head map
|-- Reference-map diff
|   |-- added: path -> hash; removed: path -> hash; updated: path -> [old, new]
|   |-- Reject repeated paths, invalid hashes and mismatched prior references
|   `-- Reverse application swaps additions/removals and old/new pairs
|-- Full restoration
|   |-- Replay base chain; reject cycles, bad depth or baseId != parentId
|   |-- Read canvas-value; clone skeleton and fill text placeholders
|   |-- Fill extracted paths shallowest first; require existing null slots
|   |-- Optional head map must exactly match the reconstructed references
|   `-- Legacy expanded checkpoints pass through
`-- Reuse during workspace validation
    |-- recordHistory requests reuseImmutableRecords = true
    |-- WeakMap is keyed by checkpoint object
    `-- Reuse expanded snapshot only if reference map and item identities match

Publish a saved checkpoint [C/D/O]
|-- MappingDiagramService supplies capture callback to catalog capability
|   `-- Requires project, publishCheckpoint method and checkpoint capture adapter
|-- CanvasCatalogStore parses request and serializes publication
|   |-- Queue belongs to this store instance
|   |-- Existing requestId + identical JSON signature -> return saved receipt
|   |-- Same requestId + different signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   `-- Existing target must be settled, match revision and retain repository ownership
|-- WorkspaceRecordStore.capture pins one manifest
|   |-- Require header.headId == checkpointId and metadata.version == expectedVersion
|   |   `-- expectedVersion is document metadata version, not manifest revision
|   |-- Hydrate selected head + its exact bound diagram revisions
|   `-- Stored history references ALL checkpoint/revision/item keys for this document
|       `-- Each reference uses $diagramRecord: workspace and manifest's blob hash
|-- Catalog publication
|   |-- Build temporary one-head history for document extraction and catalog rules
|   |-- Resolve repository from request, existing target, metadata or scene inference
|   |-- Replace new revision's content with capture.stored, retaining archived references
|   `-- One writeJsonAtomic call contains catalog heads and request receipt
|       `-- Already committed workspace blobs are shared; old catalog history stays cold
|-- General catalog save
|   |-- DiagramPersistence validates history and diagrams
|   |-- Store diagram records, revision records and encoded history items first
|   `-- Replace expanded data with references, then call writeJsonAtomic
`-- Related publication lifetimes
    |-- Archive changes metadata while retaining encoded histories
    |-- Import preparation stores portable context snapshots before returning workspace
    `-- Export expands contexts in current documents AND historical checkpoints

Selective reads: each result has different dependencies [D/M]
|-- loadCanvasCheckpoint
|   |-- With head map: read selected checkpoint, skip its base chain
|   |-- Without head map: bounded base replay, maximum delta depth 31
|   `-- Load unique value items, then their text items; verify item hashes
|-- DiagramPersistence.currentHistory
|   |-- Normal case: head + bound revisions; baseline=head, past/future empty
|   |   `-- Remove head's parent; preserve missing revision parents in revisionBoundary
|   `-- Saved views or recording: restore archived graph with current validation

|   `-- Manifest -> workspace index -> document metadata/history headers
|       `-- Return documentId/type/canvasViews without checkpoint or revision bodies
|-- CanvasCatalogStore.loadDiagramSourceBindings
|   |-- Passes EVERY catalog revision's history to DiagramPersistence.sourceBindings
|   |   `-- Each history's head -> bindings -> revisions -> diagram source binding
|   |-- Cache key includes project, path, inode, size, mtime and ctime
|   |-- Coalesce in-flight reads; invalidate cache on rejection; return cloned result
|   `-- Source bindings deduplicate by JSON value; last identical occurrence wins
|-- Full restoreDiagramData
|   |-- Cache reads and hydrated results by kind:id within the operation
|   |-- Require allowed kind and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters in references
|   |-- Return structured clones for hydrated references
|   `-- Evidence objects bypass traversal; captured source text is not nested records
`-- Meaning of history=current on workspace load
    |-- Worker requests current validation and deserializes with that mode
    `-- Store read still fetches every manifest blob when its raw-manifest cache misses
